title: Restart Chromium under the kiosk user service

verify.summary: Transitive dependency TASK-052-T2-FT-003-W4 is blocked by TASK-046-T3-FT-003-W2; TASK-054 cannot be promoted or executed through the blocked capture path.

Fresh independent T3 verification passed source-managed Restart=always policy and three advertising/active/result recovery cases. A module-aware disposable-profile probe confirmed readable retained token/camera/JPEG/sensor configuration, discarded personalized state and no realtime POST/replay. Real pilot-host evidence remains deferred by the accepted local-development decision and is not claimed.

Fresh adversarial review passed current systemd Restart=always semantics, strict live-check failure behavior and an isolated exact-PID SIGKILL probe across advertising, active and result states. Managed configuration survived; personalized/session/cache/database state and realtime replay remained absent. No material semantic finding or operator decision remains in TASK-054 scope.

Explicit manual lifecycle owner closed TASK-054 after independent functional PASS and per-task semantic-pass. Exact-PID Chromium replacement across advertising, active and result states retained managed kiosk configuration, discarded personalized state and replayed no realtime work. No material finding or operator question remains; accepted pilot-host evidence deferral is preserved as a later follow-up and is not a current queue blocker.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-012 RED: no managed user-service recovery proof exists; GREEN: with central HTTPS reachable, terminating Chromium/client in advertising, active and synthetic result-holding states causes automatic process replacement/reload as display, returns to advertising, retains the manually configured central display credential plus camera/quality/sensor settings, and discards prior personalized result, reference frames, QR/session token and active Attempt; decisive comparison: pre/post profile/state probes and redacted service output distinguish retained kiosk configuration from discarded personalized state; artifact: reports and Playwright transcripts under .tasks/TASK-054-T3-FT-003-W5/.
purpose: Implement automatic browser replacement/reload while preserving only managed kiosk configuration.
success_outcome: The user service automatically restores usable advertising after browser failure without losing the central credential or reviving participant state.
anti_goals: Do not promise offline start when the origin is unreachable.
Do not rotate/reveal credentials or restore personalized state.
Do not own kiosk sandbox policy or execute the recovery runbook.

forbidden_scope: Central runtime check owned by TASK-051-T3-FT-003-W4
stop_conditions: Reachable-origin reload cannot return to advertising.
Personalized-state discard would erase managed central-token configuration.

constraints: Use the source-managed display-user systemd unit with Restart=always and sandbox intact.
Exercise advertising, active and synthetic result-holding states on the pilot host.
invariants: Automatic recovery needs no operator action when origin is reachable.
Managed central display credential survives; personalized QR/session/Attempt/frame state does not.
Recovery replays no search and mutates no server credential/serving state.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-012 process replacement/reload in named states.
Retained managed configuration versus discarded personalized-state comparison.
User-service identity, sandbox and Restart=always inspection.
